archetypes.name: dyn-prune-window
archetypes.rationale: Round-aware prune activation controls reviewer coverage risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the reviewer-prune window change and its tests. Check that round 2 can prune from exactly one prior launched round, while rounds 3 and 4 still require two recent ledger rows. Verify that round 5 and the environment override remain fail-open or inactive as intended. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
